name: teacher forcing shifts exactly once
test:
import torch
targets = torch.tensor([[4, 5, 0], [7, 8, 9]])
assert torch.equal(shift_targets(targets, 1), torch.tensor([[1, 4, 5], [1, 7, 8]]))

name: padding does not change loss
test:
import torch
base_logits = torch.tensor([[[3., 0., 0.], [0., 3., 0.]]])
base_targets = torch.tensor([[0, 1]])
extra_logits = torch.cat([base_logits, torch.tensor([[[100., -100., 0.]]])], dim=1)
extra_targets = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2]])
a = masked_cross_entropy(base_logits, base_targets, 2)
b = masked_cross_entropy(extra_logits, extra_targets, 2)
assert torch.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-6)

name: model and greedy decoding are batched
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(13)
model = ReverseModel(12, 6)
source = torch.tensor([[2, 3, 4], [5, 6, 0]])
logits = model(source, torch.tensor([[1, 4], [1, 6]]))
assert logits.shape == (2, 2, 12)
out = greedy_decode(model.eval(), source, 1, None, 3)
assert out.shape == (2, 4)
assert torch.equal(out[:, 0], torch.tensor([1, 1]))
